title: Connect physical AC1024 VIEWPORT callbacks to transactional output qualification

source.typeEvidence: The physical identity join is recorded in p5-ac1024-viewport-physical-output-readback-2026-10-31.json; ODA Open Design Specification 5.4.1 §20.4.38 identifies DWG VIEWPORT entity type 34. The implementation also verifies the retained source frame type/entity flags at runtime.
source.fixturePolicy: Existing repository DWG only. No DWG or DXF fixture was added.

implementation.summary: The finalizer connects only the witnessed pair of type-34 entity callbacks to output qualification. It requires their current-generation retained source frames, unique typed paper-space VIEWPORT membership in the unique Layout1 viewport list, the expected adapter-projected group 68/69 values, the reciprocal LAYOUT/BLOCK_RECORD route, and one emitted source-bound VIEWPORT identity in the correct section with its mapped owner. The physical selector confirms complete typed field/dependency readback and the actual derived group 68/69 values.
implementation.scope: Exact AC1024 witness profile only. Other type-34 profiles remain unresolved unless separately source-bound and qualified. This output-identity proof is not independent CAD semantic or consumer qualification.

qualification.strictExport: Still refuses before publication at 213/228. The failed attempt leaves the published identity set and qualification count empty.
qualification.legacyRetry: Succeeds and atomically publishes 213 source-bound identities.

failureAndRetry.negativeControl: Set VIEWPORT 0x28B viewHeight to positive infinity. ASCII and Binary writes refuse atomically and preserve the pre-existing destination sentinel and published qualification state.
failureAndRetry.retry: Restore the original value and retry with the same adapter for each encoding. The exact type-34 qualification identities are present only after successful publication; fresh import confirms both selected viewport profiles.

physicalReadback.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary. Confirms opaque source-frame identity, complete typed field projection, paper-space container membership, extension DICTIONARY/XRECORD owner edges, derived 68/69 values, atomic refusal with unchanged qualification state, exact identity publication, and corrected same-adapter retry.

census.result: PASS; strict conversion refused at 213/228 with no published identities, and the Legacy retry published 213 while leaving the 15 unresolved callbacks unqualified. Scratch source and executable stayed outside Git.

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; touched warning-as-error build, physical selector, strict-gate CTest and source-bound census were used.

completedItemsRemoved: Connect physical AC1024 type-34 VIEWPORT callbacks 0x28B and 0x290 to transactional source-bound output qualification, mapped owner/type checks and fresh ASCII/Binary readback.
